# Synthetic v1/v2 compatibility fixture handoff

All fixture data is fabricated, candidate `1:0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`, symbol `TEST-ONLY`, mode `synthetic_demo`. The transport is a local mock recorded as `offline_mock`; no real model/API, candidate research, live report or financial assessment is involved. No existing RAY/BLISS files are changed.

- Positive v2: `synthetic-v2-r2/report.json`; exact-byte digest and all artifact/evidence hashes are bound. `reasoning.json` profile `scooby.reasoning/2` contains action, rationale, counterevidence and reversal conditions with resolving IDs.
- Positive v1: `synthetic-v1-r2/report.json`; profile `scooby.reasoning/1` has no recommendation. Must remain readable without an invented action.
- Negative fixtures: `negative-r2/<case>/report.json`; names and expected rejections in `fixture-manifest.json`. Every mutation except stale-sidecar-hash is deliberately re-bound to valid report and sidecar hashes, to test semantic validation rather than merely stale bytes. Cases cover unsupported version, wrong candidate/version, missing recommendation, blank action/rationale, missing reversal conditions, unresolved evidence/counterevidence and a valid but unrelated input/evidence pairing. The stale-sidecar test deliberately leaves the digest binding unchanged.
- Run `python build_and_check.py` in this folder: 13 producer-side checks passed (two positive, 11 negative). `generate_negative.py` produced 11 independently consumable fixture directories and `fixture-manifest.json`; it intentionally refuses to overwrite an existing fixture set.

Consumer owners should run their own independent backend/native web/standalone reader/PDF tests on the fixtures, verify canonical report/sidecar/evidence hashes and identity, and surface the appropriate rejection without leaking a partial action. Test native action, rationale, counterevidence and reversal conditions, readable source/input links, v1 fallback, malicious text escaping, and full-PDF coverage. All-pages PDF review remains separate. The producer checks establish referential/contract integrity, not factual entailment, source validity, live model quality or human approval. Root says cross-workstream v2 acceptance is not yet frozen: fixtures are shared for testing, not permission to emit v2 into real consumer paths.
